WITH `bucket_aggs` AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 1
            WHEN `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 2
            WHEN `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 3
            WHEN `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 4
            WHEN `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 5
        END AS `bucket`,
        COUNT(*) AS `cnt`,
        AVG(`ss_ext_tax`) AS `ext`,
        AVG(`ss_net_paid_inc_tax`) AS `net`
    FROM `store_sales`
    WHERE `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 1 AND 20
       OR `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 21 AND 40
       OR `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 41 AND 60
       OR `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 61 AND 80
       OR `ss_quantity` BETWEEN 81 AND 100
    GROUP BY `bucket`
),
`range_aggs` AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 1 THEN `cnt` END) AS `cnt1`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 1 THEN `ext` END) AS `ext1`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 1 THEN `net` END) AS `net1`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 2 THEN `cnt` END) AS `cnt2`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 2 THEN `ext` END) AS `ext2`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 2 THEN `net` END) AS `net2`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 3 THEN `cnt` END) AS `cnt3`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 3 THEN `ext` END) AS `ext3`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 3 THEN `net` END) AS `net3`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 4 THEN `cnt` END) AS `cnt4`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 4 THEN `ext` END) AS `ext4`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 4 THEN `net` END) AS `net4`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 5 THEN `cnt` END) AS `cnt5`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 5 THEN `ext` END) AS `ext5`,
        MAX(CASE WHEN `bucket` = 5 THEN `net` END) AS `net5`
    FROM `bucket_aggs`
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(`r`.`cnt1`, 0) > 1071 THEN `r`.`ext1` ELSE `r`.`net1` END AS `bucket1`,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(`r`.`cnt2`, 0) > 39161 THEN `r`.`ext2` ELSE `r`.`net2` END AS `bucket2`,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(`r`.`cnt3`, 0) > 29434 THEN `r`.`ext3` ELSE `r`.`net3` END AS `bucket3`,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(`r`.`cnt4`, 0) > 6568 THEN `r`.`ext4` ELSE `r`.`net4` END AS `bucket4`,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(`r`.`cnt5`, 0) > 21216 THEN `r`.`ext5` ELSE `r`.`net5` END AS `bucket5`
FROM `reason`
JOIN `range_aggs` AS `r` ON `reason`.`r_reason_sk` = 1
WHERE `reason`.`r_reason_sk` = 1
